THAI NGUYEN UNIVERSITY OF AGRICULTURE AND FORESTRY
ADVANCED EDUCATION PROGRAM
APPLICATION FORM – EXCHANGE PROGRAM
A – PERSONAL INFORMATION
Family name; First name; Date of Birth; Gender; Place of Birth; Country of Citizen; National identity number; Passport number; Issue Date; Expiry Date; University's name; Major
B – CONTACT DETAIL
Residential address; Phone and Email address
C – ACADEMIC RESULTS
Academic year; GPA
D – ENGLISH LANGUAGE PROFICIENCY
Listening; Speaking; Reading; Writing
Excellent; Good; Fair; Poor
E – COURSE SELECTION
Academic year applied (example 2024-2025)
Bachelor of Environmental Science and Management
Bachelor of Agricultural economics
Bachelor of Food Technology
Bachelor of International Tourism Management
Master of Environmental Science
Master of Biotechnology
F – PERSONAL STATEMENT (Limit your answer to 250 words)
G – REFERENCE
Title; Family name; Given name; Position/title; Relationship to applicant
H – CHECKLIST OF DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE
Copy of student ID card
Copy of passport
Letter of recommendation
Academic transcript
Health Check (by local hospital)
English certificate (optional)
Motivation letter
Others
I – APPLICANT'S DECLARATION AND SIGNATURE
Full name; Signature; Date
note_zh: 原件是已填2024–25範例，非空白當期表；僅人工摘錄必要欄位與文件清單，未複製姓名、生日、地址、證件號碼、聯絡或個人陳述。分號表示欄位分隔，不宣稱原件連續逐字版面。
